about_the_game:
About This Demo

This demo lets players experience the early chapters of the romance simulation [Casanova Simulator].
You can explore the main gameplay systems and get a feel for the story, character interactions, and affection mechanics.

Included in the Demo:

  • Approximately 1 hours of playable content

  • Introduction of the protagonist and one romanceable characters

  • Full access to the dialogue choice and affection system

  • Basic item collection and inventory features

  • One complete romance event and a preview of the affection progression system

  • Partial voice acting and sample background music

Not included in the Demo:

  • Additional romanceable characters and full story routes

  • Advanced item crafting and hidden storyline unlocks

  • Endings and post-romance events

  • CG gallery, achievements, and bonus scenes available in the full version

This demo serves as a preview of the gameplay and tone of [Casanova Simulator] and does not represent the final content or balance of the full release.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: The game is a romance simulation where players increase female characters’ affection by choosing the right dialogue options. Once the affection level reaches a certain point, the player can form a romantic relationship with the character. Players can also collect items to unlock hidden storylines.
